verses.text: May Yahweh answer you in the day of trouble. May the name of the God of Jacob set you up on high,
lines: May Yahweh answer you in the day of trouble.
May the name of the God of Jacob set you up on high,

verses.text: send you help from the sanctuary, grant you support from Zion,
lines: send you help from the sanctuary,
grant you support from Zion,

verses.text: remember all your offerings, and accept your burned sacrifice.
lines: remember all your offerings,
and accept your burned sacrifice.

verses.text: May he grant you your heart’s desire, and fulfill all your counsel.
lines: May he grant you your heart’s desire,
and fulfill all your counsel.

verses.text: We will triumph in your salvation. In the name of our God, we will set up our banners. May Yahweh grant all your requests.
lines: We will triumph in your salvation.
In the name of our God, we will set up our banners.
May Yahweh grant all your requests.

verses.text: Now I know that Yahweh saves his anointed. He will answer him from his holy heaven, with the saving strength of his right hand.
lines: Now I know that Yahweh saves his anointed.
He will answer him from his holy heaven,
with the saving strength of his right hand.

verses.text: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust in the name of Yahweh our God.
lines: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses,
but we trust in the name of Yahweh our God.

verses.text: They are bowed down and fallen, but we rise up, and stand upright.
lines: They are bowed down and fallen,
but we rise up, and stand upright.

verses.text: Save, Yahweh! Let the King answer us when we call!
lines: Save, Yahweh!
Let the King answer us when we call!
